page.text:
A basis converts a vector space into a coordinate space, but the number
of basis vectors is independent of the chosen basis. This invariant is
dimension. The dual space then records every linear way to measure a
vector, and the interaction between a map and its dual clarifies rank,
annihilators, and changes of coordinates.
